annotations.title: Function order sheet: food quantities for an event (paid, $1)

description:
Function catering quantities from head chef Cristopher's verified answers. Styles: plated, alternate drop, buffet (1-3 proteins), family-style, canapes, grazing, breakfast buffet, morning tea, afternoon tea, working lunch. Send guests and style; get grams or pieces per guest and totals for protein, sides, salads, dessert, bread and canapes. Add ingredients and price per kg for the weight to buy and cost per head, with workings. Only a 200 answer is charged; refusals and 404s are free.

Use when the user is catering an event and asks how much food to order for N guests. Send guests and style; for canapes give durationHours, or canapesBefore true when they come before a sit-down meal; for buffet give proteinCount (1-3). A field that doesn't go with the style is a free 400. For the weight to buy and cost per head, add buy lines naming an item key from a first answer (protein, protein-1, starch...) and an ingredient check_coverage lists under yieldCost. Pass on notCovered as given: nothing missing is filled in. Costs $1. Paid automatically in USDC with x402 (test USDC when this server is set to base-sepolia), within this server's per-session and per-day spend caps. Only a 200 answer is charged; 400, 404 and 422 are free. Set dryRun to true to check for free whether this would be answered and what it costs; nothing is signed. If unsure what is covered, call check_coverage first (free). Not every answer is chef-verified: say "chef-verified by Cristopher" only when the result's label says exactly that; otherwise say it is not chef-verified. A refusal is final: don't rephrase the question to get around it.

ingredient.description: An exact name GET /v1/coverage lists under yieldCost (or an alias).

item.description: The key of an item this order weighs in grams, e.g. protein, protein-1, main-a, starch.

share.description: This ingredient's part of the item's weight.

dryRun.description: Free quote only: check whether this would be answered and what it costs. Nothing is signed or charged.
